# Coding instructions

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) first. This repository is Shu Zhang's customized al-folio v1 site; that file is the authoritative source for ownership, overrides, dependency wiring, build commands, and validation.

Use [upstream v1 documentation](https://github.com/alshedivat/al-folio/tree/main/docs) for general al-folio behavior. The historical instructions about copying all layouts, includes, Sass, feature scripts, or icon fonts into this site no longer apply.
